::: {.callout-warning}
## Instructor only
This page shows nothing unless you are signed in as the instructor. It is not hidden, because hiding a page in a static site is theatre. It is protected by row level security in the database, which is the part that actually works.
:::

<div id="lms-instructor"></div>

---

### If this page is empty

Two possibilities.

**Account mode is not configured.** Questions are arriving as email at [rifkynauvalhsp@gmail.com](mailto:rifkynauvalhsp@gmail.com) rather than in a table. That is the default and it is a perfectly reasonable way to run a public book. To move questions into this inbox, follow `lms/README-lms.md`.

**You are not signed in as the instructor.** Use the sign in button in the navigation bar with the instructor address. The database policy recognises that address and unlocks the inbox; every other signed in reader sees only their own questions.
